requirement: DanceFlow policy: the legacy key majority_rules is NOT UCWDC Majority Rules and is never silently reinterpreted or migrated into a body-certified method. A legacy identifier maps only through the explicit three-row map (ordinal_majority, callback_tally, proficiency_rating); every other legacy value returns an explicit error (COMP_METHOD_LEGACY_UNMAPPED), never a fallback engine.

tests.name: the legacy map holds exactly the three explicit keys
no legacy mapping targets a UCWDC, NDCA or WSDC method
competition_scoring_legacy_map inserts exactly the TypeScript LEGACY_SCORING_MAP

The rounds/programs CHECK constraints and the legacy create actions still ALLOW storing majority_rules, skating, wsdc_callback, relative_placement, custom and none; storing is permitted, scoring is not (they stay unmapped and fail closed). DEV counts are in the R-07 report.
